Job Description
GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS
Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team with a passion for the markets, with individuals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.
OPERATIONS
Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted division that partners with all areas of the firm to deliver banking, sales and trading, and asset management capabilities to clients around the world. Alongside this vital service delivery role, Operations provides essential risk management and control, preserving and enhancing the firm’s assets and its reputation.
The Futures Operations team supports the clearing and settlement of futures and options contracts in China markets, the primary daily responsibilities include processing, validating and settling futures transactions. The team has extensive interaction with internal and external parties to ensure effective oversight for existing business but also to shape and implement solutions for new products, strategies and systems.
We are looking for a highly motivated individual, who is a team player. This person needs to multi-task well, have excellent client service skills and possess good organizational skills and be able to adapt quickly to an ever-changing list of issues. Additionally, the role will require extensive coordination and communication with various operations teams and professionals across the firm.
How You Will Fulfill Your Potential
Working with a team of Operations professionals in providing critical front to back trading support
Identify gaps in processing and make recommendations to close those gaps
Establish relationships with brokers, custodians and vendors to streamline workflow wherever possible
Lead projects, e.g. new business designs, architecture transformation and process automation, etc.
Act as escalation point to senior Operations managers for issue resolution
Conduit to business stakeholders in influencing decision making
Skills & Experience We’re Looking For
Attention to detail and good follow up skills
Demonstrate leadership and ownership of issue resolution
Self-motivated and driven to achieve
Analytical in identifying solutions to problems
Ability to manage pressure and prioritize multiple tasks daily
Team-player, excellent communication skills
Excellent spoken and written English and Mandarin
Preferred Qualifications
Minimum of 4 years of experience working in Operations from China onshore futures brokers, especially on KYC & Client onboarding
Understanding of local regulatory and market practice
China Futures Association qualified
About Goldman Sachs
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

Pillar 1: Model Hosting & Inference Optimization
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable model hosting systems to support large-scale deployment of AI models (LLMs, embedding models, STT/TTS, etc.) across diverse hardware platforms.

Design and build end-to-end, scalable model fine-tuning pipelines to support domain-specific adaptation of pre-trained using custom, domain-specified datasets.
Collaborate with data scientists and domain experts to understand domain requirements, define fine-tuning objectives, and validate fine-tuned model performance against domain-specific metrics.
Integrate fine-tuned models into the existing hosting and inference infrastructure, ensuring smooth handoff from fine-tuning to deployment.

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team: hiring, coaching, performance management, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture.
Own delivery outcomes end-to-end, including roadmap planning, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and execution against timelines and quality standards.

Bachelor’s/Master’s/PhD degree in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related fields.
3+ years’ experience leading teams, including people management and delivery ownership.
5+ years of experience in AI, with proven expertise in both model inference optimization/hosting and model fine-tuning pipeline development; experience with LLM-related work is a strong plus.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, CUDA; familiarity with GPU/CPU architecture and high-performance computing (HPC) principles.
Deep understanding of AI model inference: KV cache management, batch processing, quantization (INT4/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ), operator optimization, and inference framework integration (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, etc.).

Experience with performance benchmarking, monitoring, and troubleshooting for both inference and fine-tuning systems.
Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Role
As a Principal Engineer, Application Platforms in CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture you’ll shape technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for next-generation application and AI platforms. The role focuses on accelerating time-to-market for a major platform while improving resilience and reducing operational overhead through integrated controls and open-source solutions. You’ll play a key role in progressing Kubernetes-as-a-Service (KaaS) by defining target architectures, setting technical direction and aligning plans across multiple teams. You’ll act as the senior technical authority for early product onboarding ensuring solutions are production-ready from day one across security resilience performance and operability. Job Description
We are seeking a Head of Client Technology, VP to lead the development and delivery of high-impact client-facing technology solutions. This is a senior leadership role that requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strategic vision, and strong team leadership capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing complex technology initiatives, driving digital transformation, and ensuring the security and scalability of mission-critical systems. With a strong focus on innovation and emerging technologies, the candidate will be instrumental in shaping the future of client technology at AMC Tech.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and optimization of client-facing applications, ensuring alignment with business and technical goals.
Drive the security of the third-party supply chain, including the evaluation and management of open-source libraries, and conduct regular code scans (e.g., SonarQube, Snyk) to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Lead or contribute to system architecture integration and upgrades, resolving complex technical challenges and delivering scalable solutions.
Develop and maintain modules of self-developed systems, ensuring operational safety, stability, and performance.
Oversee the development and project management of key business systems, including sales platforms, CRM, marketing platforms, and product lifecycle management systems.
Stay at the forefront of emerging FinTech trends and introduce innovative technologies that enhance business capabilities and client value.
Lead the integration and application of AI/ML technologies to enhance client experience, automate processes, and drive data-driven decision-making.
Provide strategic leadership to the team, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
Qualifications And Requirements
Education: Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years in a team leadership or project management role.
Industry Experience: Proven experience in asset management application development, including fund sales, marketing systems, CRM, marketing integration platforms, product lifecycle management systems, and e-commerce mobile apps.
Technical Expertise:
Proficient in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and security design specifications (e.g., OWASP Top 10).
Strong knowledge of the Spring family (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security), distributed architecture, and microservices design.
Extensive experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).
Experience in leading large-scale system architecture upgrades or re-engineering projects.
Strong background in AI/ML technologies, including experience in deploying AI/ML models, integrating AI into business workflows, and leveraging AI for client-facing applications.
Leadership & Team Development: Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams, with a track record of talent development and team performance.
Soft Skills: Agile mindset, fast learner, excellent communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Additional Preferred Qualifications:
Familiarity with AI technologies and experience in AI application development.
Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate effectively with global stakeholders.
Experience in leading digital transformation initiatives and AI-driven innovation.

Job Summary
Lead the global Securities & Secondary Loan Trade Processing Technology organisation, owning trade processing capabilities across securities, repo, financing and secondary loan products, including trade capture, lifecycle processing, settlement integration, asset servicing, financing events, controls, exception management and operational resilience.
Own the strategy, architecture and delivery roadmap for resilient, scalable and well-controlled trade processing platforms, ensuring accurate and timely processing from trade capture through settlement, servicing and lifecycle completion.
Drive platform modernisation, application simplification, AI-enabled engineering, automation, data quality improvement and observability to increase processing efficiency, reduce operational risk and improve platform resilience.
Lead the evolution of strategic securities and financing processing capabilities, enabling business growth, product expansion, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
Provide senior engineering leadership across a global organisation, ensuring architecture, security, data, risk and operational design decisions translate into accurate, scalable and well-governed business outcomes.
Act as the senior technology partner for Markets Product, Markets COO, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Architecture and Markets Technology leadership on securities and financing processing strategy, transformation and service performance.
Key Responsibilities
The role holder leads others and is accountable for strategy, delivery outcomes, technology risk management, investment prioritisation, stakeholder alignment and organisational capability across the global Securities & Secondary Loan Trade Processing Technology organisation.
Strategy and Transformation
Define and execute the multi-year Securities & Secondary Loan Trade Processing technology strategy, aligned to Markets priorities, enterprise architecture standards, regulatory obligations and business growth objectives.
End-to-End Capability Ownership
Own securities and secondary loan trade processing capabilities from trade capture and enrichment through settlement, financing lifecycle events, asset servicing, accounting integration, exception management and completion, with accountability for processing accuracy, timeliness and control effectiveness.
Platform Ownership and Business Outcomes
Lead resilient, standardised and scalable trade processing platforms and services, improving settlement efficiency, lifecycle processing effectiveness, control integrity, platform stability, service quality and business responsiveness.
Architecture and Platform Modernisation
Drive simplification of legacy application estates and convergence toward strategic trade processing capabilities, reducing fragmentation, technical debt and operational complexity while improving agility and long-term sustainability.
Controls, Risk and Regulatory Readiness
Strengthen processing controls, reconciliation, data quality, auditability, entitlement governance, observability and cyber resilience, ensuring platforms operate within regulatory expectations and the Bank's risk appetite.
AI, Automation and Engineering Excellence
Lead adoption of AI-enabled engineering, intelligent automation, workflow technologies and observability capabilities to improve software quality, engineering productivity, operational efficiency and root-cause resolution effectiveness.
Portfolio Governance and Investment Management
Partner with Technology and Business leadership to prioritise investment, manage run and change spend, address platform risks and technical debt, and provide transparent executive reporting on delivery, resilience, regulatory and platform health outcomes.
Enterprise Leadership and Stakeholder Management
Influence senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Architecture to align strategic priorities, investment decisions and transformational outcomes.
People and Talent
Lead a globally distributed engineering organisation spanning engineering, platform services, architecture and delivery leadership.
Build a high-performing, engineering-led culture focused on accountability, innovation, continuous improvement and business ownership.
Develop future leaders and establish strong succession pipelines across critical technology capabilities.
Champion AI-enabled software engineering, platform ownership, DevOps excellence and modern engineering practices.
Create an inclusive environment that attracts, develops and retains exceptional technical talent.
Skills And Experience
Must-have Skills
Software Product Business Knowledge
Technology Strategy, Innovation and AI Enablement
Technology Platform and Engineering Leadership
Other Skills
People Leadership and Team Culture
Strategic Stakeholder and Portfolio Management
Operational Resilience and Service Management
Motivations
The ideal candidate is motivated by building strategic platforms that safeguard the integrity of securities, financing and loan processing across Financial Markets. They are energised by leading complex transformation initiatives, modernising critical platforms and delivering measurable improvements in operational resilience, risk management and business outcomes.
They thrive on solving large-scale processing, settlement and servicing challenges, influencing enterprise-wide technology decisions and building high-performing engineering organisations that deliver lasting business value through innovation, automation and AI-enabled transformation.
Qualifications
Key Experiences
Extensive experience in Markets Technology with strong knowledge of Securities & Loan trading and post-trade processing.
Proven leadership of large-scale engineering teams and mission-critical technology platforms.
Strong understanding of trade processing, lifecycle management and regulatory expectations.
Experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation.
Demonstrated success delivering strategic change while maintaining operational stability.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Certifications / Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Languages
English
